name: Otay Ranch Town Center
description: Otay Ranch Town Center is a premier open-air lifestyle shopping destination in Chula Vista, California, featuring a dynamic mix of national retailers, popular dining options, and entertainment venues. Located in the master-planned Otay Ranch community, this center serves the South Bay region with convenient access and ample parking. The center combines upscale shopping with a vibrant outdoor atmosphere, making it a popular gathering place for residents and visitors alike.
summary: A vibrant open-air lifestyle center in Chula Vista offering upscale shopping, dining, and entertainment in the heart of the Otay Ranch community.
